text: Maya Dev: Heads-up — cutoff in ~90m for v0.23.2. Quick sherpa checklist below, please reply with ✅ when done or call out blockers.
messages:
Maya Dev: Heads-up — cutoff in ~90m for v0.23.2. Quick sherpa checklist below, please reply with ✅ when done or call out blockers.

Maya Dev: Checklist (target branch `release/v0.23.2`):
  - bump package/version tags (ops: `tools/release bump && git push`)
  - changelog entry in /docs/CHANGELOG.md (one-paragraph summary)
  - run smoke + regression suite on staging (SHA pinned)
  - security quick-scan (Snyk + deps audit)
  - docs spotcheck and link-check
  - owners signoff for feature flags + canary window
  - schedule canary rollout + rollback plan

Jamal Eng: I can own the canary rollout and rollback plan. Will schedule 30m canary starting +2h, will post exact window. ✅

Steph QA: On smoke/regression — I'll run the tests now against `staging-3309` and post failures. If flaky tests appear, I'll create a temporary test-runner tag and assign to the flaky-tests board.

Caroline Docs: I'll grab the changelog blurb and do a quick link-check. If I need wording clarifications I'll ping PR authors.

Liam Security: Quick note — ran an incremental audit, flagged one transitive dep (grpc@1.x) for a minor advisory. Not blocking for cutoff but need a follow-up ticket to bump to patched range. I'll add the ticket and mark it P2. :eyes:

Maya Dev: Thanks — for the flagged dep do we have a short mitigation? If not, we'll include in release notes as 'pending dependency patch'.

Liam Security: Mitigation: pin our build to the patched CVE-free resolver and add a CI check. I'll open the PR now (assigning to @jamal).

Jamal Eng: Got it. I'll watch the PR. Canary will have the build that includes the pin.

Steph QA: Smoke run started. Initial results: 3 failures in reranker tests (likely infra flake). Re-running with cached KV; will update in 10m.

Caroline Docs: Changelog drafted: "v0.23.2 — bugfixes and dependency hardening; includes security pin for grpc transitive dep and several latency fixes to the batching layer." Dropping the doc PR now.

Maya Dev: Deployment bot — can we get a quick check that `release/v0.23.2` branch is up-to-date with main?

Deploy Bot: branch-status: `release/v0.23.2` is 0 commits behind main. Last CI: ✅  (artifact: build-3309-rc). Canary window scheduled by Jamal at 3309009600 - will trigger rollout.

Steph QA: Regression rerun — 1 flaky left, not a blocker for canary. Marking QA as ✅ for cutoff.

Maya Dev: Docs ✅ from @Caroline. Security flagged but issue created (P2) — OK to proceed. Jamal, confirm you have canary plan and target hosts?

Jamal Eng: Confirmed. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 30m -> 25% 1h -> full if stable. Health checks + latency SLO guard rails with automatic rollback on >5% error or 20% latency regression. I'll post the canary runbook in #oncall shortly. :shipit:

Maya Dev: Great. Final ask: if you haven't bumped the package.json version, please do so ASAP and post the PR link here. We'll cut the tag 15m before cutoff.

Caroline Docs: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/PR/4532 — changelog + release notes.

Jamal Eng: Version bumped in tools/release PR: https://git.internal/redwood/PR/4540 — ready.

Deploy Bot: tagging scheduled: `v0.23.2` at 3309001260.

Maya Dev: All right — rolling the tag at cutoff unless any objections. Thanks everyone for quick turn. :tada:
